findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 second, so existing callers that rely on the default now get a 1-second floor on every wait. Before this change the effective floor was 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any caller such as wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1) or wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.01) that does not pass min. Mechanism: the return expression max(max(0, self.min), min(result, self.max)) now clamps every result up to self.min=1, so the sub-second backoffs the caller configured are silently replaced by 1-second waits. Impact: retry timing changes for existing users after upgrade, with the configured initial value ignored whenever it is below 1 second.
